title: An affine etale neighbourhood on which the global sections of a flat finitely presented module are projective
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, for a module of finite presentation flat at a point over a locally finitely presented base, an affine elementary etale neighbourhood and an affine open containing the lifted point such that the global sections of the restriction are projective over the ring of the neighbourhood (statement lines 5661-5671, tag 05ME). The proof is a real reduction: it makes the module flat over the base by openness of flatness, arranges that the associated points of the special fibre are generalizations of the point by shrinking, uses the flat along the fibre lemma to get an etale neighbourhood with projective global sections, and then proves purity of the restriction on an affine open inside the image by lifting an associated point along the etale morphism and pushing a specialization forward. That lifting argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
